name: Watchlist opens for a signed-in reader
description: After signing in with an email code, the watchlist page shows its alerts card and its watched items card instead of sending the reader to sign in.

planSteps.description: Type testsprite-account-03+clerk_test@example.com into the "Email address" field and click Continue
On the verification code screen, type 424242; if a Continue button is still shown after the sixth digit, click it
Assert the URL path is no longer under /sign-in within 30 seconds
Assert the URL path is /watchlist and both the alerts card (data-testid watchlist-alerts) and the watched items card (data-testid watchlist-items) are shown
